purpose: Help machines, agents and monitors choose safe read-only tests by default and reserve Cloudflare KV write budget for controlled sandbox or customer operations.

reason_for_profile.event: Cloudflare Workers KV free-tier daily put limit warning
reason_for_profile.risk: Unbounded automated tests can create too many KV put operations.
reason_for_profile.operational_response: Daily monitoring must run in no-write mode. Full sandbox tests require an explicit write budget decision.

customer_records.writes_when: Creating or updating sandbox or beta customer records.

usage_ledger.writes_when: Scoring, purchase intents, payment-test intents and payment-test webhooks update customer ledger state.

default_monitor_policy.full_mode_rule: Run Full mode manually only when KV and Durable Object write budget is acceptable.

endpoint_budget.notes: Use these calls for machine discovery, smoke checks and daily monitoring.
Reads may consume API execution time but should not write KV.
Creates one sandbox daily-limit tracker record update, two customer lookup records and one ledger initialization.
Admin-only customer creation. Use sparingly and never in unattended loops.
Admin-only customer and credit update. Use for controlled setup, not daily monitoring.
Consumes one score credit and writes ledger state. Reuse a customer key and idempotency key during tests.
Consumes one product credit and writes order intent state. Use only after score routing recommends a next product.
Creates simulated payment-test state. No real payment is executed.
Simulates provider callback state. No live provider or real invoice is used.

agent_rules: Daily checks must use NoWrite mode unless explicitly approved.
Prefer public GET discovery before creating sandbox keys.
Reuse existing sandbox or beta keys during test sessions.
Use idempotency keys for every write endpoint.
Never run unbounded loops against POST endpoints.
Treat sandbox customer creation as the main KV budget risk.
Escalate to human supervision before high-volume Full tests or paid Cloudflare upgrade decisions.

next_recommended_test.name: bounded_write_budget_probe
next_recommended_test.description: Run one explicit Full-mode sandbox flow, then compare reported API behavior with this budget profile.

latest_score_volume_quality_review.conclusion: The 10-score batch is commercially coherent and conservative enough to proceed to a bounded 25-score test, with one caution: nurture at confidence 0.52-0.54 should remain low-cost only.
latest_score_volume_quality_review.recommended_next_step: Run a 25-score bounded test only after preserving NoWrite daily monitor policy and avoiding purchase intents.
